title: Pick Up Weapon For Selected Character?

posts.author: finalrpg777
posts.body:
I watched the Youtube tutorial on how to select a character before starting the game (RPG Maker MV - How to make a better Character Selection).
What I want to do is: When I select my character Leon instead of Claire (placeholder names) I want the shotgun to appear on the map only when my character Leon is chosen and not when Claire is chosen.
I tried doing it with Erase Event but the shotgun appears on the map when Claire is chosen and will only disappear when she tries to grab it.
I'm not using plugins.
I attached a screenshot of my event.

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
Do two event pages instead and check for the hero in party as a condition on the left side.
Or - if "in case of Claire" - nothing should happen, one page is enough with checking for Actor Leon.
"Erase Event" doesn't do what you seem to expect. It removes the event temporarily until you re-enter the map. If you want it gone forever, you have to use conditions like switches or the actor check.
PS: Your event does get erased when she tries to grab the weapon, because your "erase event" is only executed as soon as you interact with the event.
